Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

steps.input: await rlm.harness.create_memory(title='ARC lattice row/column line extension with colors 2 and 3', path='arc', global_=True, content='Continual-ARC task-cd1b4264. Grid is partitioned by full 8 separators into rectangular cells (each tile interior all zero except sparse seed pixels). Convert any seed-containing tile to a solid tile of that seed color, and connect same-color seed tiles along straight shared tile rows/columns: color 2 and color 3 both extend from one seed to another aligned seed, inclusive, replacing all intervening tile interiors with that color. When extended 2 and 3 lines intersect, fill the overlap tile with color 6 (as in demos). Preserve the 8 divider lines and leave all other tile interiors 0. Demos: seeds 2 at same tile-column create vertical color-2 run between extrema; aligned same-row 2 seeds also connect horizontally. Color 3 seeds connect similarly. Practical rule: build lines between aligned same-color seeds; overlap=6. Task test solved after recognizing multiple aligned lines (initial wrong assumptions were extending entire rows/columns without needing matching seeds).')
